first_date_selection: Exclude only dates actually observed at the same exact key, including same-observation neighboring granule/reprocessing duplicates. Within unchanged frozen catalogue bbox/native-frame contacts, rank declared scene cloud then acquisition time then literal item ID. No global date veto or unnecessary monotonic/latest-date cutoff; all chosen winners also happen to be later than the current latest January16. Quality metadata does not establish clear/valid centre or surface class.
scientific_read_contract: Preserve raw10mRGBNIR DN+masks andnative20mSCL+masks separately, actualfractionalcentre andcompleteacquisition/processingidentities.
Qualityclasses/cloud/shadow/nodata are source-modelevidence, neverautomaticwater/land/bodytruth; genuinelyinvalidorambiguousobservations remainunknown.
PB05true/nonzeroassetoffsetcontradiction literal. No blindSTAC−.1 application orCOGdefaultscale1/offset0calibrationclaim; rawonlyuntil reviewedcontract.
Future value and mask reads require a distinct complete-plan review and explicit parent launch. Current header preparation has zero value or mask reads.

complete_item_resource_declaration.operator: Custom reviewed native Rasterio read and atomic NPZ custody; no Baseline/NewVintage helper or deployed asset package.
complete_item_resource_declaration.disk_admission_basis: Actual free compared with this complete planned output plus explicit modest emergency margin at launch. No arbitrary global reserve floor.
complete_item_resource_declaration.failure_rule: Fail the entire item on the first source, mask, compression, metadata, status or storage error; preserve completed whole blocks and failure records. No partial natural-group scientific completion or adoption.
complete_item_resource_declaration.generic_helper_and_premerge_policy: No repository limits changed. The256MiB generic evidence-preparation ceiling is an implementation bound, not a universal custom-operator bound (accepted docs/AUDIT_FAILURE_PREVENTION.md). Actual final packet bytes and any generic validator applicability will be reported separately; no unsupported generic-gate pass.
complete_item_resource_declaration.selection_rule_unchanged: Parent-requested quality-aware scheduling from the same frozen catalogue and genuinely unobserved exact-key dates, with unchanged raw reader and all actual prior observations retained. Quality rank and complete per-key candidate proof are separately bound. No desired-surface filtering or arbitrary group slicing.

historical_header_input_selection_rule_u: Quality-aware next observation requested by parent after actual January11/16 cloud-only results. Among the same complete frozen unfiltered catalogue contacts at each exact original centre, require acquisition calendar date strictly later than that key latest actual observation; exclude same-observation duplicates/reprocessing. Rank declared scene cloud first, then acquisition time and literal item ID. No desired surface class, actual source values or per-key masks are inspected for selection. Other keys dates/items do not veto a candidate. Metadata quality remains context rather than proof of valid clear centre data; reuse compatible prior whole blocks.
